extracted.name: Microwave cauliflower, apricot & green olive tagine
extracted.description: Use your microwave to make a quick cauliflower, apricot and green olive tagine. This midweek-friendly meal borrows all the flavours of a slow-cooked tagine
ingredient_lines: 1 medium head of cauliflower chopped into small florets
175ml vegetable stock made using 1 vegetable stock cube
large handful of coriander roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Put the oil, onion, and a pinch of salt in a large, microwavable bowl, then cover and cook on high for 5 mins. Add the garlic and spice mix and stir. Cover again, then cook for 2 mins. Remove from the microwave and add the cauliflower and cook for 3 mins more.

Pour in the canned tomatoes and stock, then cover and cook on high for 8 mins. Stir in the apricots, chickpeas and olives, then cover and cook on high for 7 mins. Leave to stand for 5 mins, then season and stir through most of the chopped coriander. Serve with fluffy couscous and yogurt, topped with the remaining coriander.
